title: Iran war live: Iranian missiles target Kuwait, Bahrain after US-Iran clash
content: Live updatesLive updates, Iran war live: Iranian missiles target Kuwait, Bahrain after US-Iran clash The United Nations reports that 1.4 million people are in need of aid in Lebanon amid Israel’s attacks on the country. Published On 6 Jun 2026 - Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said it attacked “enemy bases in the region”, hitting them with “aerospace missiles”, in a statement carried by the semi-official Tasnim news agency. - The United States military said Iran fired seven missiles at the Gulf neighbours Kuwait and Bahrain, but none reached their targets.
